rows.grounds: compound of māna, unmāna, and pramāṇa in instrumental case
sakala with vat suffix indicating likeness
past participle of smṛ in neuter nominative or accusative singular

items.question: How is the whole body remembered when measured by measure and unmeasure?
premises: all parts are remembered as complete-like
items.inference: the ritual body is proportioned by measured and unmeasured standards
uncertainties: exact referent of māna, unmāna, and pramāṇa remains unclear
whether smṛtam is nominative or accusative is unresolved
items.plain_english: By the measure of measure and unmeasure, all is remembered as complete-like.
